title: Backend asset serving: JS_URL, static dirs, templates from dist
answers: How does Django decide which built assets to serve?
Where is frontend/dist wired into Django settings?
body:
- Backend never picks hashed JS filenames; esbuild bakes them into dist/index.html. Django supplies `js_url` (context["js_url"] = `get_js_url(request)` in posthog/utils.py) and preload hints.
- `get_js_url`: returns settings.JS_URL; under DEBUG with localhost host on non-secure request, rewrites hostname to request origin. JS_URL defaults to http://localhost:8234 in DEBUG else "" (posthog/settings/__init__.py); prod can be a CDN.
- posthog/settings/web.py: `STATIC_URL="/static/"`, `STATICFILES_DIRS=[frontend/dist]`; DEBUG adds an extra dir for /static/services/*; TEMPLATES DIRS include frontend/dist so index.html/layout.html/exporter.html/render_query.html resolve there first (per agent's summary).
- In DEBUG (non-test), template context gets `vite_dev_scripts` with source_path src/index.tsx / src/exporter/index.tsx / src/render-query/index.tsx (Vite dev path).
- head.html sets window.JS_URL.
